title: Distant Gaia DR3 stars — 100–2,000 pc

queries.distant-field:
SELECT TOP 500000
    g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error,
    g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ruwe, g.b,
    g.phot_bp_rp_excess_factor,
    g.phot_bp_mean_flux_over_error, g.phot_rp_mean_flux_over_error
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
WHERE g.parallax >= 0.5
    AND g.parallax_over_error > 10
    AND g.ruwe < 1.4
    AND g.visibility_periods_used > 8
    AND g.phot_g_mean_flux_over_error > 50
    AND g.phot_bp_mean_flux_over_error > 10
    AND g.phot_rp_mean_flux_over_error > 10
    AND g.bp_rp BETWEEN -1 AND 6
    AND (g.parallax<=10 AND g.random_index<5000000)

sampling.method: Keep the smallest -log(U) * candidateInclusion / importance; U is the 52-bit midpoint of SHA-256(source_id). Candidate inclusion is 1 for G<9 or the full WD-region query, otherwise fieldRandomIndexLimit/gaiaSourceCount.
sampling.interpretation: Smooth weights emphasize luminous and white-dwarf regions without hard display-group quotas; inclusion factors reduce enrichment-pool overrepresentation; this is not a statistically representative density sample

distanceMethod: 1000/parallax_mas; positive parallaxes with SNR>10; no zero-point correction; formal errors exclude systematics
extinction: No extinction correction; color and absolute G are observed values affected by dust
photometryQuality: abs(corrected BP/RP excess C*) <= 3 sigma, Riello et al. 2021 Table 2 and Eq. 18; sigma evaluated at G>=4
parentSelection: Same astrometric and photometric quality criteria as nearby stars; full-depth all-sky field cohort enriched with bright and white-dwarf query pools over 100–2,000 pc; no additional apparent-magnitude cutoff on the combined sample; smooth importance sampling without replacement
selection: 0.5 <= parallax <= 10 mas (100–2,000 pc); no additional apparent-magnitude limit
completeness: A teaching sample with extra stars from sparse diagram regions; Gaia detection and quality limits remain; not a complete census or confirmed type classification
